model_selection: bounded inner CV entirely inside fit subset; calibration/test labels withheld
neural_objective: assay-weighted smooth L1 in pEC50 coordinates
question: How should pretrained Nesso-1 be adapted with 25–500 PXR cellular-activation labels?
report_interval_guarantee: No distribution-free coverage guarantee asserted for chemical shift
se_floor_rationale: Fixed before new outcomes from the existing protocol floor grid; engineering cap, not independently measured assay precision.
purge_predicate: Morgan radius2/2048 Tanimoto >=.35 to ANY original chemical TEST member; includes calibration
subset_policy: Filter exact original seeded full draw orders; nested acquired prefixes; ceil(.2*N) calibration suffix; fit-only subsets need not nest
feasibility: Structure-only all-five-fold intersection of supported requested budgets, plus eligible-full; no threshold fallback; individual invalid inner-CV contracts are retained failures

method_configs.original: Original prepared protocol frozen here, no duration caps; Morgan ridge alpha [1,100,10000]
method_configs.readouts: Use full frozen protocol_readouts.json for its two ridge methods; alpha [1,100,10000,1000000]
method_configs.baselines: Use frozen module constants and protocol_baselines.json; descriptor slot separately named feasible recipe, NOT exact historical restoration

method_flows.native_continuous: frozen cached Nesso vectors -> released native head -> 6-native affinity; no target-label training; endpoint-mismatched pIC50-equivalent
method_flows.weighted_median: fit labels -> inverse-SE weighted lower median -> constant
method_flows.native_affine: frozen native scalar -> fit-only inverse-SE weighted squared affine regression, slope [0,2], free intercept
method_flows.head_pretrained: frozen member vectors -> released twin continuous head initialization -> within-fit grouped inner LR/epoch choice -> independently trained seeds -> mean
method_flows.head_random: same twin head architecture/random initialization -> same fitting/selection -> mean
method_flows.morgan_ridge: Morgan bits -> within-inner/final train-only preprocessing and weighted ridge -> grouped inner alpha choice
method_flows.descriptor_lightgbm_rdkit_mordred: canonical SMILES -> frozen row-wise RDKit2D+Mordred2D+Morgan -> inner/final training-only learned preprocessing/selectors -> LightGBM; distinct from unavailable historical feature universe
method_flows.repr_ridge_unscaled: concatenated frozen vectors -> unscaled weighted ridge; grouped inner alpha selection
method_flows.repr_ridge_stable: concatenated frozen vectors -> train-only weighted mean and floored SD per readout protocol -> weighted ridge; grouped inner alpha selection

postprocessing: No point clipping. Calibration suffix labels only for conformal absolute-residual intervals, no distribution-free coverage guarantee under shift.
launch_gate: Require verified A/B modules, protocols, descriptor identity cache and passing A/B/strict tests bound to source hashes; freeze complete source/input/runtime bindings before smoke and outcome panel.
queue: five folds x ten draws x supported budgets plus eligible-full x fixed nine methods; two threads, systemd user, no elapsed-time cap
